notes: The plan's own Verification bullet "A timed Gate 8 run reports a wall-clock under 600s" was NOT confirmed under load this dispatch: the host carried loadavg >= 3 and multiple concurrent sibling dispatches throughout this phase (same condition Phase 1's own deferred-baseline record names), and a standalone gate31 (slow-bucket) run alone took between 10-15 minutes under that load. A full, honest gate8-alone timing run was not completed this dispatch given the cost (10+ minutes per attempt under contention) and the risk of contaminating a sibling dispatch's own measurement. The mechanism's CORRECTNESS is proven at the gate/test level (test-gate-slow-bucket-split.sh's case (a): the slow/non-slow split covers exactly the 209 really-discovered suites, mutually exclusive, read-only against the real tree) and gate31 standalone passed cleanly (9 suites, 7 passed, 2 expected failures, 0 NEW). Phase 8's own final full-gate-set run is where the authoritative Gate 8 wall-clock figure, under whatever load exists at that time, gets recorded -- consistent with this task's Phase 1 precedent of never presenting a contaminated figure as a clean control.
